stem: Meena pours 200 mL of water from a bottle into a round bowl in her kitchen. The water spreads to take the shape of the bowl, but its volume stays 200 mL. Which statement correctly explains this?

options.text: The water particles break down into smaller particles when poured.
The water particles can move and change positions while attractions keep them close together.
The water particles are tightly fixed in one position and cannot move at all.
The water particles are far apart and move freely in all directions like a gas.

teacher.key_rationale: Liquids have a fixed volume because particle attractions keep particles close, but particles can slide past one another, so the liquid takes the container's shape. A wrongly suggests particles break down; C describes a solid; D describes a gas. Key recalculated as B.
